name: messaging-send-topic-accepted
description: firebase-admin/messaging send() to a topic: FCM accepts and returns the message resource name projects/<projectId>/messages/<numeric id>. dryRun=true returns a name in the SAME format (fake id), so callers cannot distinguish validation from acceptance by shape alone.
